Kicked off the Nothingness Linux debug app and smoke-tested transport controls via `drive.py` (VM service extensions).

### 1) Launch (desktop)
`drive.py preflight` recommended starting `flutter run -d linux --debug -t dev/main_debug.dart` with isolated log/fifo paths.

- Log: `/tmp/flutter_run_nothingness_linux_debug.log`

### 2) Play / Pause smoke test
- `drive.py pause` → `playback.isPlaying: false`
- `drive.py resume` → `playback.isPlaying: true` (and `currentIndex` remained `1`)

### 3) Skip smoke test (`next`)
Because `next/prev` rely on a queue, I set a 2-item queue (both entries point to the same mp3 since this repo only contains one audio file).

```bash
drive.py call ext.nothingness.setQueue \
  paths="/workspace/soloud/src/filters/signalsmith-stretch/web/demo/loop.mp3,/workspace/soloud/src/filters/signalsmith-stretch/web/demo/loop.mp3" \
  startIndex=0
drive.py resume
```

Then:
- `drive.py next` → `playback.currentIndex` changed `0 -> 1` and playback continued (`isPlaying: true`)

### 4) Fast-forward smoke test (`seek`)
- `drive.py seek 0:05`
- Subsequent `inspect` showed `isPlaying: true` and `songInfo.position` moved forward (near the requested ~5s mark; after ~1s it advanced further as expected).

### Commands used (core)
- Play track:
  - `drive.py play /workspace/soloud/src/filters/signalsmith-stretch/web/demo/loop.mp3`
- Pause/resume:
  - `drive.py pause`
  - `drive.py resume`
- Queue + skip:
  - `drive.py call ext.nothingness.setQueue paths="<mp3>,<mp3>" startIndex=0`
  - `drive.py next`
- Fast forward:
  - `drive.py seek 0:05`
